name: Blizzard Challenge 2023
ability_definition: The ability to communicate information and ideas in speaking so others will understand.

task_realism.reasoning: Systems synthesize speech from supplied French text, mostly audiobook-style sentences. Reading prepared text aloud is a real workplace activity, such as announcements, narration, or scripted presentations. But most workplace Oral Expression means explaining, answering questions, and adapting content to listeners. None of that is exercised, because content is fixed in advance.

evaluation_conditions.reasoning: A strength is that human listeners judge the output, which matches the 'so others will understand' criterion. Single-playback transcription adds some realism about comprehension under limited exposure. However, the listening is controlled and non-interactive, over short isolated utterances. There is no dialogue, no listener feedback, no noisy environment, and no stakes. SUS sentences are deliberately unnatural inputs.

construct_coverage.reasoning: The benchmark covers intelligibility, naturalness and prosody through MOS and MUSHRA ratings, and pronunciation accuracy through the homograph test. These are the delivery layer of spoken communication. It omits forming, selecting and organizing ideas, tailoring to audience, and conveying meaning beyond the given text. It is a narrow slice of the ability.

format_match.reasoning: The output is genuine speech audio, a real communication artifact. Inputs are text strings, some of them artificial constructs (semantically unpredictable sentences, homograph probes). Evaluation happens through rating scales and transcription rather than through task outcomes that depend on understanding.

transferability_reasoning: Blizzard 2023 validly measures whether synthesized speech is intelligible and natural to human listeners, which captures the delivery component of Oral Expression. Because systems only vocalize given text in isolated, non-interactive settings, it says little about composing and communicating ideas in real workplace speech. Transfer is therefore partial and limited to read-aloud scenarios.

2023.metric: MOS, 1-5 scale (listeners rated quality/naturalness on the Hub task FH1)
2023.human_reference: General adult workforce who read prepared text aloud in work settings (announcements, presentations, reading scripts), in French
